coordinates.origin: Center of intended two-foot contact footprint, Z=0; identity root.

concept.reason: Real skull views and fossil assemblage plus identified museum reconstruction sufficient.

scope: Whole long-legged long-necked waterbird with broad duck-like bill; not isolated skull or fossil slab.

scale.height_provenance: AMNH species educational estimate, not one measured articulated individual.
scale.skull_provenance: Smithsonian Fig8/9 Presbyornis sp. specimen, separate genus-level comparison; not assigned to AMNH28505 or exact P.pervetus model.
scale.model_head_status: Reconstruction choice near genus evidence; soft tissue and species uncertainty.

diagnostic_targets: Tall slender exposed legs clearly unlike short-legged duck, elevated body and narrow long neck.
Broad gently expanded and flattened duck-like bill; no flamingo down-kink or heron spear tip.
Compact feathered trunk, paired folded wings and short feathered tail.
Both feet include three forward toes joined by broad webbing plus small elevated rear toe.
Neck rises with mild natural bend, not extreme swan loop; small head relative to full height.
Restrained natural brown/cream coat, not official illustration bright colors claimed as fact.
uncertainties: AMNH28505 is a multi-individual disarticulated assemblage, not a single measured complete skeleton.
Presbyornis sp.90mm skull is a distinct specimen and genus-level evidence only.
Feather pattern, color, pose, neck soft contour and model head length are reconstructions.
Use modern anseriform classification, not1980paper broader evolutionary claims.
acceptance: Original stilt legs plus long neck plus broad duck bill all retained.
Foot webs physically join toes with thickness; legs and folded wings separate/readable.
No source image texture copying or full skeleton substituted for living target.
Four exactGLB views, two reproducible builds, independent QA.
material_profile: Palette-only opaque PBR, six original muted brown/cream/gray colors; no textures.

runtime_profile.current_claim_scope: Local candidate for independent anatomical/visual/specification review. Parse only; GPU, populated-scene performance, user approval and publication are not established.

implementation_notes: The 100 mm head/bill working length is measured along authoring Y from the cranium rear to the bill tip; this is an artistic reconstruction parameter, not a measurement of AMNH 28505.
The delivered posed height is 0.999 m. The small difference from the 1.0 m educational estimate is contact-grounding tolerance, not measured palaeometric precision.
Folded wings, each toe, webs, tail feathers and eyes remain separate editable closed solids; adjoining parts intentionally intersect. This is not a Boolean-union or printable-mesh claim.
